theme_and_archetype.reasoning: A high-contrast, functional, and authority-driven CRM interface ensures clarity for fast-paced sales operations. The specific requested colors (Deep Red, Emerald, Charcoal) work best when paired with stark light backgrounds and sharp components.

typography.heading_strategy: Outfit provides a clean, modern, and slightly authoritative presence for dashboards without feeling overly corporate. Banned fonts (Inter, Roboto) are avoided to maintain a premium feel.

layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Generous spacing strategy. Use p-6 or p-8 for desktop panels. Mobile cards use p-4 or p-5.
layout_and_spacing.border_radius: Subtle roundness. Cards use rounded-xl. Buttons use rounded-lg. Avoid pills unless for status badges.

split_screen_desktop.left_pane: col-span-4 lg:col-span-3 border-r border-zinc-200 bg-zinc-50 h-screen flex flex-col p-6 items-center justify-center
split_screen_desktop.right_pane: col-span-8 lg:col-span-9 h-screen overflow-y-auto bg-white p-6 md:p-10

mobile_first_closer.card: bg-white border border-zinc-200 rounded-xl p-5 mb-4 shadow-sm relative
mobile_first_closer.sticky_actions: fixed bottom-0 left-0 right-0 bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-xl border-t border-zinc-200 p-4 z-50 flex gap-3 max-w-md mx-auto

buttons.primary: bg-[#8B0000] text-white hover:bg-[#700000] active:scale-95 transition-all shadow-sm font-semibold h-12 w-full
buttons.call_action: bg-[#8B0000] text-white rounded-full p-4 shadow-lg hover:shadow-xl hover:-translate-y-1 transition-all flex items-center justify-center

lead_card.structure: Header (Name & IG ID) -> Body (Category, Notes) -> Footer (Follow-up Date, Closer Notes) -> Absolute Call Button floating on right side
lead_card.phone_link: text-[#8B0000] font-bold text-lg flex items-center gap-2 tap-highlight-transparent

forms.inputs: Shadcn inputs customized with h-12, bg-zinc-50 focus:bg-white focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#8B0000]/20 border-zinc-200

tables.style: Go cardless. Full-width tables with sharp borders, row hover states (hover:bg-zinc-50). Status columns use distinct colored badges.

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Cards elevate slightly (-translate-y-[2px]) and cast a soft shadow (shadow-md) on desktop. Buttons have a scale-95 press state.
motion_and_interactions.list_animations: Staggered fade-in and slide-up for lead cards when loading.
motion_and_interactions.modals: Use Shadcn Dialog with backdrop-blur-sm. Smooth slide-up entrance for mobile.

icons.usage: Use stroke-width 2.2 for a crisper, more premium look. Icons should be sized at 20px (w-5 h-5) typically, or 24px (w-6 h-6) for main call actions.

login_background.description: Abstract white curved architectural background used for login screen right side panel

testing_attributes.instructions: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid. Format: kebab-case, role-based.

instructions_to_main_agent: Prioritize mobile-first design for the Closer view, implementing smooth bottom-sticky actions and card-based tap-friendly layouts.
Ensure standard HTML input/select elements are completely avoided for complex interactions (use Shadcn Select, Dialog, Calendar).
Use 'Outfit' for all Headings (H1-H4) and 'Manrope' for body text. Add the fonts to tailwind config and main css via Google Fonts import.
Install and configure 'lucide-react' for all icons.
Admin/Lead Filler split screen must be side-by-side on desktop, hiding the sidebar on mobile or reflowing it into a top bar.
The 'Deep Red' (#8B0000) must primarily serve as the action color for calling and urgent 'Not Called' statuses, while 'Emerald' is exclusively for success/approved.
